scheme_name: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must have been registered for at least 6 months before death.
Death can be due to natural causes or an accident.
The worker must possess a valid identity card.

Beneficiary must be the spouse (wife or husband) holding a valid identity card, or sons and unmarried dependent daughters, or dependent parents, or any other family member dependent on the deceased worker if none of the above apply.
benefits_summary: Provides a funeral assistance of ₹6,000 and ex‑gratia payments ranging from ₹1,00,000 to ₹4,00,000 depending on the cause of death or disability.
documents_required: Application form in the prescribed format
